notes.title: Update: Villagers
notes.notes:
When I was making the announcement trailer, something felt off ... the worlds felt empty.

Naturally, after some necessary features were completed, villagers were added to Mini Worlds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/b992f40522a6d43adbc8542cee185e31a5e0aca1.png[/img]

Now, your worlds, cities and villages will have people roaming around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128589/b72e1bfacd01e41ec660161f7df6f9e5f86528d2.png[/img]
